title: project.created
description: A project was declared. It is the partition every other entity of the log lives in (D25): the class of a graph, the registry of skills and the keys of a hook are unique inside one project, never across the database.

name.description: What a person calls this project, and what the screen's switcher and `cartografo --project <name>` address it by. Unique across the database. The envelope's project_id and entity.id already carry which project this is, so the name is the one field of the row the envelope cannot say.
